name_note: Most GTDB species of Jutongia are uncultured genomes without published names; the published species of the genus include Jutongia huaianensis.

sentences.text: A study of anaerobic strains isolated from healthy Chinese adults proposed the new species Jutongia huiwenae, whose closest named relative was Jutongia huaianensis.
In that study the four isolated strains, one of them the new Jutongia species, produced short-chain fatty acids and showed distinct carbon utilisation and enzymatic profiles.
In stool of 39 breast cancer patients before neoadjuvant chemotherapy, a study reported Jutongia enriched in those who later achieved a pathological complete response.

references.title: Identification and characterization of four novel gut bacterial taxa: Alvibacillus kangbaii gen. nov., sp. nov., Jutongia huiwenae sp. nov., Flintibacter aciditolerans sp. nov., and Dizhoua hominis gen. nov., sp. nov. isolated from human feces
